title: Connect your WhatsApp number
description: Link your WhatsApp Business number to Cheerio so you can send campaigns
examplePhrases: how do I connect my WhatsApp

steps.title: Go to Channel Settings
steps.instruction: Click Channels in the sidebar to open your channel settings.

steps.title: Find WhatsApp
steps.instruction: You'll see the WhatsApp card. Click 'Connect WhatsApp' to start.

steps.title: Follow the connection steps
steps.instruction: Complete the on-screen steps to verify your WhatsApp Business number.

steps.title: Confirm connection
steps.instruction: Once connected, the status will show a green 'Connected' badge. You're all set!
